scripts.build: npm run build:preview && npm run build:mcp && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && vite build
scripts.build:preview: esbuild preview/render.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=browser --conditions=workerd,worker --target=es2022 --minify --define:process.env.NODE_ENV='"production"' --outfile=functions-lib/preview.gen.js --log-level=warning && cp ../node_modules/@resvg/resvg-wasm/index_bg.wasm functions-lib/resvg.wasm && cp ../node_modules/@expo-google-fonts/inter/400Regular/Inter_400Regular.ttf functions-lib/inter-400.bin && cp ../node_modules/@expo-google-fonts/inter/600SemiBold/Inter_600SemiBold.ttf functions-lib/inter-600.bin && cp ../node_modules/@expo-google-fonts/inter/700Bold/Inter_700Bold.ttf functions-lib/inter-700.bin
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:preview && npm run build:mcp && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p functions/tsconfig.json
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npx --yes wrangler@4.156.0 pages deploy
scripts.preview:pages: npm run build && npx --yes wrangler@4.156.0 pages dev --port 5190 --binding API_ORIGIN=http://localhost:8080
